legacyBody: This task was created before the projects screen. Its clips are shown here, and each clip can be edited on its own.
scoreDisclaimer: The score is Polixor's internal estimate of how strong a moment is. It does not promise views or engagement.

progress.canLeave: You can close this page – the work continues, and the project will be waiting for you here.

short.title: Short clips
short.body: The strongest moments, each as its own clip: vertical framing that keeps faces and content in frame, subtitles and a strong opening.

longform.title: Long video
longform.tagline: From hours of stream to a 10–30 minute video
longform.body: A different algorithm from shorts: it finds the main topics, removes dead air, repetition and off-topic parts, and keeps chronological order and a natural flow. Includes chapters.

analysis.title: What we found in the video
analysis.subtitle: Everything here was actually measured during analysis.
analysis.momentsHint: A preview – the actual selection happens at generation, based on your settings.
analysis.layoutsHint: Reaction = camera over content. Camera = the camera fills the screen. Screen = content without a camera.
analysis.noTranscriptBody: Without a transcript there are no subtitles, and selection relies on audio and video signals only.

settings.shortSubtitle: Aspect ratio, length, count and layout.
settings.longSubtitle: The target length of the edited video.
settings.clipCountHint: The maximum. If there are not enough strong moments, fewer will be created.

auto.label: Automatic (recommended)
auto.hint: Each part gets the layout that fits it: reaction when there is a facecam, face tracking for a full camera, and a fit for the screen when there are no faces.

reaction.label: Reaction – content and camera
reaction.hint: Two panels: content and camera together, without cutting the face.

face.label: Face tracking
face.hint: A vertical crop that follows the face.

center.label: Center crop
center.hint: A fixed crop in the middle of the frame.

blur.label: Full frame with blurred background
blur.hint: The whole original frame is visible, with a blurred background above and below.

settings.layoutNotNeeded: In 16:9 no cropping is needed – the original frame is kept.
settings.facecamFoundBody: In automatic mode, parts with a facecam are shown as content and camera together.
settings.targetHint: The result will be this length ±12%. If there isn't enough good content it will be shorter, and you will see why.
settings.longHow: Polixor splits the transcript into topics, removes silences, AFK, repetition and parts unrelated to the main topic, and takes the best continuous passage from each topic – in chronological order, with a sentence of context before it. Parts are joined with a soft transition.
settings.contentLanguageHint: Affects content analysis and subtitle direction.
settings.subtitlesSubtitle: Subtitles are burned into the video, synced to the spoken words.
settings.subtitlesOff: The video will be created without subtitles. No SRT file will be created.
settings.subtitlesNoTranscript: This video has no transcript, so there will be no subtitles even if you turn them on.
settings.savedAutomatically: Settings are saved to the project automatically.

results.emptyBody: No moment passed the quality bar for these settings. The selection report below shows the near misses and why they were rejected. You can lower the quality bar in Settings.

review.title: Selection report
review.subtitle: {{selected}} clips passed the quality bar ({{threshold}}) out of {{stories}} possible stories.
review.lowConfidence: {{pct}}% of the words were recognized with low confidence

empty.selected: No moment passed the quality bar.

performance.title: Processing time
performance.hint: Real measurements from this project. RTF = processing time ÷ video length (0.25 = four times faster than real time). Indented rows are the parts of each stage.
